questions.question_text: Which organ pumps blood throughout the human body?
questions.explanation: The heart is a muscular organ that pumps blood to all parts of the body through blood vessels.
questions.supporting_quote: It pumps blood through blood vessels called arteries

questions.question_text: How many chambers are present in the human heart?
questions.explanation: The human heart has four chambers: two atria and two ventricles.
questions.supporting_quote: The human heart has four chambers: two atria and two

questions.question_text: Where is the heart located in the human body?

options.A: Slightly to the left of the chest cavity
options.C: Above the diaphragm on the right

questions.explanation: The heart is a muscular organ located slightly to the left of the chest cavity.
questions.supporting_quote: located slightly to the left of the

questions.question_text: Blood is carried away from the heart mainly through which vessels?
questions.explanation: Arteries carry blood away from the heart, while veins return blood to it.

questions.question_text: Which statement best describes the function of the circulatory system?

options.A: It digests food into simpler substances
options.B: It carries blood to every part of the body
options.C: It filters waste from the bloodstream only

questions.explanation: The circulatory system carries blood, and therefore oxygen and nutrients, to every part of the body.
questions.supporting_quote: The circulatory system carries blood to every part of the body
